release_notes: Android Discover remembers your scroll position when you return from a recipe.
Recipe thumbnails show loading progress and keep photographs discovered on the full recipe page.
The RecipeCove logo now fits the Android header without clipped letters or an opaque background.
The Recipe Critic and other publisher previews try an additional supported source for recipe details.
When a publisher blocks automatic imports, you can view and review the available information with a link to the original recipe instead of hitting an unexplained 422.
